company.shortDescription: Cambridge Aerospace develops air defense systems for detecting and intercepting aerial threats.
company.description: Cambridge Aerospace develops air defense systems for detecting and intercepting aerial threats. Its products include Skyhammer, a modular interceptor designed for drones and cruise missiles; Starhammer, a high-speed interceptor for higher-value missile threats; Looking Glass, a multistatic radar system; and Nightstar, a solid rocket motor. The company also develops manufacturing capabilities for producing air defense systems and propulsion components.
